description: Fix critical issues found in code review: heredoc bug, volume staleness, missing migration, domain routing, and pnpm fallback
steps: Fix CloudFormation UserData heredoc - replace with echo statements
Fix Docker volume staleness - replace named volume with bind mount or copy approach
Add database migration step to deploy flow
Fix nginx config for creatools.stream and creatools.live to serve SPA frontend for non-API paths
Remove pnpm install fallback in Dockerfile
acceptance_criteria: CloudFormation UserData uses echo statements instead of heredoc
Docker compose does not use named volume for frontend_static
Deploy script includes drizzle-kit push after containers start
Nginx serves SPA frontend on creatools.stream and creatools.live for non-API paths
verification: docker-compose.yml validated as valid YAML with correct services and volume structure
CloudFormation YAML parsed with 37 resources, 8 parameters, 6 outputs - UserData uses echo statements
nginx.conf validated with nginx -t (host resolution error expected in standalone test)
findings: All 5 critical review issues addressed. The migration step uses a one-off container approach since the production image does not include drizzle-kit or schema source files. The volume staleness fix uses a copy-on-start entrypoint that clears and re-copies frontend files on every container restart.
